category.enumNote: These five and no more: the list is a backend enum, so adding a category is a code change, not a setting.
title: Tools
warehouseDoes: Assigning, returning and dispatching happen in the warehouse · with the person there
warehouseDoes.consumables: Dispatching takes stock out and happens in the warehouse · here you register and set the minimum
kpi.consumables.total.note: Sum of the three that follow
filter.workerNote: Worker filter on · the “leaving the company: what do they have” one
filter.serverNote: The server filters and searches · {{shown}} of {{total}}
table.stock: Stock · the mark is the minimum
empty.none.lead: Register the first tool: the code is yours and can't repeat.
empty.none.body: This is for what's lent and comes back — drills, levels, harnesses. What gets used up and restocked goes in Consumables.
empty.none.consumables.lead: Register the first one with its unit and its minimum.
empty.none.consumables.body: The minimum is what sets off the traffic light; without it, everything stays green for good.
empty.filters.lead_one: There is 1 tool and it does not meet {{conditions}}.
empty.filters.lead_other: There are {{count}} tools, but none meet {{conditions}}.
empty.filters.leadConsumables_one: There is 1 supply and it does not meet {{conditions}}.
empty.filters.leadConsumables_other: There are {{count}} supplies, but none meet {{conditions}}.
error.lead: The list didn't answer. Nothing was lost.
error.body: Try again. The figures aren't loading either: they come in the same call.
forbidden.word: You don't have access to the inventory
forbidden.lead: The inventory is for whoever administers the account and whoever runs the warehouse.
forbidden.body: If you supervise a project, you see your team's tools from your own panel. There's nothing to retry.
page.consumablesOrder: Ordered by the traffic light: what's run out first
detail.history.empty: Only its registration: it has never left the warehouse
detail.holder.noneBody: Nobody answers for it right now: it can be assigned from the warehouse.
detail.holder.unsigned: Not signed for yet. The tool has left the warehouse, so it counts as out, but nobody has accepted responsibility. If they decline, it goes back to Available on its own.
detail.warehouseSolves.body: If they don't accept it, the warehouse can cancel the checkout and the tool goes back to Available. It isn't cancelled from here: the tool is on site, not at the counter.
detail.since_one: Out of the warehouse since {{date}} · 1 day unsigned
detail.since_other: Out of the warehouse since {{date}} · {{count}} days unsigned
form.code.fixedHint: It's on its label and in its history
form.code.taken: A tool with this code already exists.
form.code.takenBody: {{code}} is already in the inventory: it's {{name}}. The code is unique per company, so if they really are two machines, add a letter: {{code}}-B.
form.name: Name
form.name.hint: Make and model · it's what gets searched
form.category.hintEdit: Changing it doesn't touch the history
form.footer.new: It starts Available, in the warehouse
form.err.code: Write the code from the label.
form.err.name: Write what the tool is called.
form.err.server: It couldn't be saved. Try again.
fixStatus.title: Fix the status
fixStatus.only: Only these · from {{status}} there are no other paths
fixStatus.reason.placeholder: What happened and why the status changes…
fixStatus.err.server: The status couldn't be fixed. Try again.
fixStatus.means.available: Back to the warehouse, ready to be assigned again.
fixStatus.means.inReview: Out of circulation until it's repaired.
fixStatus.means.damaged: It can't be assigned. It stays in the inventory and in the figures.
fixStatus.means.lost: It stops counting as available, but it isn't deleted: the history stays.
fixStatus.blocked.title: The status can't be fixed while it's out.
fixStatus.blocked.body: It's in {{name}}'s hands and that person would answer for it. To change its status it has to be returned in the warehouse first: the condition chosen on return — good, minor wear, needs repair or damaged — sets the status, signed by whoever received it.
fixStatus.blocked.bodyNobody: It's out of the warehouse. To change its status it has to be returned there first: the condition chosen on return sets the status.
whoCan.none: This company has no warehouse user. Create one in Users: without one nobody can return or dispatch.
consumable.title: Register supply
consumable.name: Name
consumable.unit.hint: How it's counted and dispatched · sack, roll, box, pound, cartridge
consumable.minimum.hint: It sets off the traffic light
consumable.err.name: Write what the supply is called.
consumable.err.unit: Say how it's counted: sack, box, roll…
consumable.err.negative: Enter a number of zero or more.
minimum.title: Adjust minimum stock
minimum.new.hint: In {{unit}} · the stock isn't touched here
minimum.effect.line: With a minimum of {{minimum}} and {{stock}} in the warehouse, this supply becomes {{light}}. Nothing is dispatched or deducted: only when it warns you changes.
readOnly: To assign or return, talk to the warehouse
